summary.text: Tamie Dixon-Tatum is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Mike Gaskill.
She won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary over Todd Shelton.

paragraphs.text: Tamie Dixon-Tatum has run for office in Indiana several times before.

Ballotpedia lists her as a candidate for the same Senate seat in 2018, when she lost in the Democratic primary, and in 2022, when she won the Democratic primary over Aaron Higgins and lost the general election to Mike Gaskill, 64.1% to 35.9%.
In 2024 she sought the Democratic nomination for lieutenant governor at the party's state convention, where she received 162 votes (10.6%) and Terry Goodin won the nomination.
